newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Ahmsa ups share offer.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Ahmsa ups share offer.

text.p: Shareholders at Mexican steel company Altos Hornos (Ahmsa) have authorized the company to increase the amount of shares it plans to offer shortly, company officials said Friday.
"One of the motions approved was to raise the amount on offer, although we did not discuss by how much or when. It will depend on market conditions," a company official told Reuters.
Ahmsa shareholders in September approved an issue of 70 million shares for Mexican and international markets before year's end, but company officials have said that will depend on market conditions.
The company also had planned to offer up to an additional 55 million shares some time in 1997.
